title: CDrus Expression
description: Defines a Expression in the CDrus language. CDrus is the grammar layer in a three-pillar language architecture for describing SDLC work: CDEvents (vocabulary of what happened), CDrus (grammar of what is intended), and Koine (execution of intent against present tools). A Expression specifies an intent — build, deploy, verify, and so on — by declaring the CDEvents that together fulfill that intent. Expressions compose: a composite expression references other CDrus Expressions as constituents. Per-event field requirements live in the CDEvent schemas themselves (using one-way inheritance for vendor-specific extensions), not in the expression.

expression.description: Unique name of this CDrus Expression (e.g., 'build', 'deploy', 'verify', 'build-deploy'). Lowercase, hyphen-separated.

version.description: Semantic version of this CDrus Expression. Bumping a version signals a change in intent. Consumers may pin to a version via 'expression: <name>:<version>' syntax, or use semver ranges like 'expression: build:^1.2.0'.

description.description: Human-readable description of the intent this CDrus Expression captures.

produces.description: Ordered list of CDEvents and/or sub-expressions that together fulfill this CDrus Expression. Order is significant: events fire depth-first in the order specified — a parent event with nested produces fires, all its descendants fire (recursively), then the parent's next sibling fires. Sub-expressions are expanded recursively at the position they appear.

produce_item.description: A produce item is either a CDEvent (terminal, optionally with nested produces and/or detach lists) or a reference to another CDrus Expression (composition, no nesting). The two forms are mutually exclusive within a single item.

event_item.description: An event item references a CDEvent type to emit. It may carry a nested produces list (events triggered by this event, fired in depth-first order before the next sibling) and/or a detach list (independent chains spawned by this event, with their own chainIds and RELATION links back; the parent does not wait for detached chains to complete).

event.description: CDEvent type to emit. Multiple forms are accepted and resolve identically: (1) canonical embedded-version form 'dev.cdevents.build.started.0.1.1' (exact match); (2) colon form 'dev.cdevents.build.started:0.1.1' (exact match, equivalent); (3) no version 'dev.cdevents.build.started' (resolves to latest available); (4) colon-separated semver range 'dev.cdevents.build.started:^0.1.0' (resolves to highest matching). Standard semver range syntax applies — caret, tilde, x-ranges, and explicit ranges (the last must be quoted in YAML). Vendor-specific event extensions are referenced by their full extended type string. Detailed semver-range validation occurs at resolution time. Linters may normalize between the canonical and colon forms.

event_schema_uri.description: URI to the event's JSON Schema. Optional; consumers may fall back to local schema lookup when not provided.

produces.description: Events triggered by this event, fired depth-first in the order specified. All produced events share the parent's chainId. The parent's next sibling does not fire until every descendant has fired.

detach.description: Independent chains spawned by this event. Each detached item gets its own chainId at run time, with a RELATION link from the parent event to the first event of the detached chain. The parent does not wait for detached chains to complete; its next sibling fires immediately. Detached chains are declared (not implicit) so consumers can act as a babysitter — tracking expected detached chains, raising alerts if they fail to start or hang. Without an explicit detach declaration, an unrelated chain spawned in the runtime is unobservable to the system.

expression_item.description: A expression item references another CDrus Expression by name, optionally pinned by version or constrained by a semver range. The referenced expression is resolved and expanded recursively at run time. Expression items cannot carry produces or detach lists — those properties belong on the events the referenced expression itself produces, in the referenced expression's own definition.

expression.description: Reference to a sub-expression by name, with optional version. Forms: 'build' (latest available), 'build:*' (latest, explicit), 'build:1.2.0' (exact pin), 'build:^1.2.0' (compatible range, >=1.2.0 <2.0.0), 'build:~1.2.0' (close range, >=1.2.0 <1.3.0), 'build:1.x' (any 1.x.x), or quoted explicit ranges like "build:>=1.2.0 <2.0.0". Detailed semver-range validation occurs at resolution time.
